name: alis
description: Personal A-share quant research, simulation, backtest, and task runner.

scripts.check:risk-e2e: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location backend; if (Test-Path .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe) { .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\simulate_risk_gates_e2e.py } else { py -3.11 scripts\simulate_risk_gates_e2e.py }"
scripts.check:backend: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location backend; if (Test-Path .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe) { .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m compileall -q app } else { py -3.11 -m compileall -q app }"
